summary: BK Technologies filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a partial roof collapse at its West Melbourne, Florida headquarters and main industrial facility during an October 8, 2026 severe thunderstorm. No employees were injured. Water intrusion damaged the server room, production area and customer service areas, disrupting IT systems and temporarily limiting on-site activity. The Company activated disaster recovery and business continuity procedures and expects temporary impacts to BKR 9000 radio production, BKR 9500 production-readiness and repair services. It maintains property, inventory, business interruption and extra expense insurance and has begun the claims process; magnitude and timing of financial impact remain unestimable.
